summary: Binds pointer, wheel and key input for one visible view or flat editor, hit-tests through the view's runtime and feeds gestures, hints and cursors.

faults.when: The head's surface isn't ready, so nothing can be picked on it.

lifetime: Per visible view or flat editor; its demand is the view panel being shown.

x-friction.gap: Picking on the head needs the scene's skinned, morphed plate and occlusion (host objects), answered synchronously inside the input's cycle.
x-friction.closes: Host objects per node with a synchronous query port for plain answers.
